verdict.rationale: Deel documents an official MCP server exposing tools (contracts, payroll, time-off, etc.) that AI agents/assistants like Claude and ChatGPT can invoke, with OAuth2 handled automatically by clients and a documented connection endpoint (mcpServers config). This is a well-documented, first-party official MCP server aligning directly with the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the MCP server working in practice beyond vendor docs.
